name: core
description: Reusable Node.js foundation for small web applications

scripts.start: node -e "const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url'); const p = require('node:path').resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD || '.', 'dist/main.js'); import(pathToFileURL(p).href);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
